The Gazette of the Democratic Socialist Republic of Sri Lanka
FILLING OF A VACANCY IN THE OFFICE OF MEMBER OF THE VALIKAMAM WEST PRADESHIYA SABHA UNDER SECTION 66A(1) OF THE LOCAL AUTHORITIES ELECTIONS ORDINANCE (CHAPTER 262)
WHEREAS the office of return member of Valikamam West Pradeshiya Sabha has fallen vacant by reason of Resignation;

And whereas the Secretary of the Eelam People's Democratic Party, the recognized political party to which Sivaguru Balakrishnan the member belonged, was required by me under Section 66A(1) of the aforesaid ordinance, to decide upon returned member of Valikamam West Pradeshiya Sabha who belongs to such party and is not disqualified under section 9 of the local authorities elections ordinance (Chapter 262) and who shall be declared selected as a member within a period of thirty (30) days;
And whereas the Secretary of the aforesaid recognized political party has communicated his decision to nominate Sellamuthu Selvakkumar to fill such vacancy;

Now Therefore I, Rajendra Saseelan, returning officer of the Valikamam West Pradeshiya Sabha, acting in terms of Section 66A (1) of the Local Authorities Elections Ordinance (Chapter 262) do hereby declare that Sellamuthu Selvakkumar was selected as the member of the Valikamam West Pradeshiya Sabha. R. Saseelan, Returning Officer, Valikamam West Pradeshiya Sabha. District Elections Office,Jaffna,24th July, 2025.
